Before you come

Plan a campus visit

Veer Patta Senior Secondary School
Opp. Mela Ground, Amet, Rajasthan 313332
  1. Agree on a time

    Call the office and ask for a suitable day and time before you travel.

  2. Tell us the class you’re considering

    If transport or step-free access matters to your family, ask the office about your route or entrance in advance.

  3. Bring your questions, not sensitive documents

    Ask for current fees, the document checklist and next steps. Don’t send identity or payment details through an enquiry.

Have a question about the school?Open the parent guide · four quick answers+
Which class should we ask about first?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

See the early-years guide →
What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. The website does not quote official fees.

Contact the office →
How do we visit the campus?

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

Directions and visit details →
What can we choose in Class 11?

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.

Class 11 guide →

These are public school answers, not a live chat. No questions are recorded. For anything else, call the office.
